items.title: The naive cotangent complex computed from a factorization through a formally smooth morphism
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter more-morphisms.tex (More on Morphisms)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file more-morphisms.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: If a morphism factors as an immersion followed by a formally smooth morphism, the lemma identifies its naive cotangent complex with the two-term complex given by the conormal sheaf of the immersion followed by the pullback of the differentials of the smooth morphism, placed in degrees minus one and zero. The proof compares the factorization with a presentation of the morphism, computes the conormal sheaf of the immersion through the conormal sequence, and verifies that the resulting two-term complex is quasi-isomorphic to the naive cotangent complex. Building the comparison from the conormal sequence is the load-bearing step. Retained author proof at lines 3991-4015.
